Create Burden Percentiles 
-------
```{r}
Create_Burden <- function(analyte_list = child_list_Targeted,join_var){
  
  All_Perc <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(analyte_list)) {
    
    Curr_Analyte <- analyte_list[[i]]
    analyte_name <- names(analyte_list)[i]
    #Break into percntiles
   Curr_Perc <- Curr_Analyte %>% 
      mutate(percentile = percent_rank(!!sym(analyte_name)) * 100) %>% 
     dplyr::select(!!sym(join_var),Study,percentile)
   
   names(Curr_Perc) <- c(join_var,"Study",paste0(analyte_name,"_Percentile"))
   
   All_Perc[[i]] <- Curr_Perc
  
    
    #Place individuals into percentiles
    
  }
  return(All_Perc)
  
}
```

```{r}
Fast_Merge <- function(mylist = All_Perc,ID_Col = "Child_PID"){
  

  results_df <- mylist[[1]] %>% 
   group_by(!!sym(ID_Col),Study) %>% 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
    ungroup()
    #summarise(value = mean(col_name,na.rm = T))
  

  for(i in 2:length(mylist)){
    
    #print(i)
    
    curr_df <- mylist[[i]] %>% 
      group_by(!!sym(ID_Col),Study) %>% 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
    ungroup()
    
    #names(curr_df) <- c(ID_Col,"Study",metab_new)
    results_df <- full_join(results_df, curr_df, by = c(ID_Col,"Study"))

  }
  
  return(results_df)  
}
```


```{r}
All_Perc_Child <- Create_Burden(analyte_list = child_list_Targeted,join_var = "Child_PID")
All_Perc_Df_Child <- Fast_Merge(All_Perc_Child)

All_Perc_Mat <- Create_Burden(analyte_list = mat_list_Targeted,join_var = "Mat_PID")
All_Perc_Df_Mat <- Fast_Merge(All_Perc_Mat,ID_Col = "Mat_PID")
```

```{r}
scale_x <- function(x){
  scaled_x <- (x - min(x,na.rm = T)) / (max(x,na.rm = T) - min(x,na.rm = T))
  return(scaled_x)
}

Burden_Df_Child <- All_Perc_Df_Child %>% 
  mutate(non_missing_count = rowSums(!is.na(across(-c("Child_PID","Study"))))) %>% 
  mutate(Total_Val = rowSums(across(!c("Child_PID","non_missing_count","Study")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(Normalize_Value = Total_Val/non_missing_count) %>% 
  mutate(Burden = Total_Val/log(1 + non_missing_count)) %>% 
  mutate(Burden = Burden * Normalize_Value/100) %>% 
  mutate(Burden = scale_x(Burden)) %>% 
  #mutate(Weighted_Score = with(., weighted.mean(Total_Val, non_missing_count))) %>% 
  #dplyr::select(Child_PID,Study,Total_Val,non_missing_count,Normalize_Value,Burden,everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Child_PID,Study,Total_Val,non_missing_count,Normalize_Value,Burden,everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(non_missing_count > 5) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(non_missing_count != 0) %>% 
  #filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% 
  mutate(z_score = (Normalize_Value - mean(Normalize_Value,na.rm = T))/sd(Normalize_Value,na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(Burden_Adj = sqrt(non_missing_count) * z_score) %>% 
  mutate(Burden_Adj = scale_x(Burden_Adj) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(rank_adj = dense_rank(desc(Burden_Adj))) 

Burden_Df_Mat <- All_Perc_Df_Mat %>% 
  mutate(non_missing_count = rowSums(!is.na(across(-c("Mat_PID","Study"))))) %>% 
  mutate(Total_Val = rowSums(across(!c("Mat_PID","non_missing_count","Study")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(Normalize_Value = Total_Val/non_missing_count) %>% 
  mutate(Burden = Total_Val/log(1 + non_missing_count)) %>% 
  mutate(Burden = Burden * Normalize_Value/100) %>% 
  mutate(Burden = scale_x(Burden)) %>% 
  #mutate(Weighted_Score = with(., weighted.mean(Total_Val, non_missing_count))) %>% 
  #dplyr::select(Child_PID,Study,Total_Val,non_missing_count,Normalize_Value,Burden,everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Mat_PID,Study,Total_Val,non_missing_count,Normalize_Value,Burden,everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(non_missing_count > 5) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(non_missing_count != 0) %>% 
  #filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% 
  mutate(z_score = (Normalize_Value - mean(Normalize_Value,na.rm = T))/sd(Normalize_Value,na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(Burden_Adj = sqrt(non_missing_count) * z_score) %>% 
  mutate(Burden_Adj = scale_x(Burden_Adj) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(rank_adj = dense_rank(desc(Burden_Adj))) 

save(Burden_Df_Child,file = "../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Burden_Child.RData")
save(Burden_Df_Mat,file = "../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Burden_Mat.RData")

# Added 2026-08-10. Everything below this point plots a single `Burden_Df`, but
# the score is now built separately for the child and maternal panels and the
# combined object was never reintroduced -- which is why S11-S13 still date from
# before that refactor. Rebuilt here from the two halves.
#
# Only the columns the figures actually use are carried across: the per-analyte
# *_Percentile columns differ between the two panels (child and maternal measure
# different chemicals) and none of S11-S13 reads them, so binding them would just
# produce a very wide sparse frame.
SCORE_COLS <- c("Study", "Total_Val", "non_missing_count", "Normalize_Value",
                "Burden", "z_score", "Burden_Adj", "rank_adj")

# Child_PID and Mat_PID are both carried through, not just a merged PID: some of
# the chunks below are population-specific and address the original column.
Burden_Df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  Burden_Df_Child %>% dplyr::transmute(PID = as.character(Child_PID),
                                       Child_PID = as.character(Child_PID),
                                       Mat_PID = NA_character_, Population = "Child",
                                       dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(SCORE_COLS))),
  Burden_Df_Mat   %>% dplyr::transmute(PID = as.character(Mat_PID),
                                       Child_PID = NA_character_,
                                       Mat_PID = as.character(Mat_PID), Population = "Maternal",
                                       dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(SCORE_COLS)))
)

stopifnot(nrow(Burden_Df) == nrow(Burden_Df_Child) + nrow(Burden_Df_Mat))
message("Burden_Df rebuilt: ", nrow(Burden_Df), " rows across ",
        dplyr::n_distinct(Burden_Df$Study), " cohorts")
```

#Example of high and low Burden Individuals
Case study of a lot of alot, a little of a lot, a lot of a little, and a little of a little 

```{r}
Adj_Burden <- Burden_Df %>% 
  #dplyr::select(Child_PID,Study,Total_Val,non_missing_count,Normalize_Value,Burden) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(non_missing_count > 5) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(non_missing_count != 0) %>% 
  #mutate(z_score_qnorm = qnorm(Normalize_Value / 100)) %>% 
  mutate(z_score = (Normalize_Value - mean(Normalize_Value,na.rm = T))/sd(Normalize_Value,na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(Burden_Adj = sqrt(non_missing_count) * z_score) %>% 
  mutate(Burden_Adj = scale_x(Burden_Adj) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(rank_adj = dense_rank(desc(Burden_Adj))) 

```

```{r, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE}   # per-individual heatmap; needs the per-analyte *_Percentile columns that the rebuilt Burden_Df does not carry, and is not one of S11-S13
Adj_Burden %>%
  dplyr::filter(rank_adj <= 30) %>% 
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Child_PID,Study,Total_Val,non_missing_count,Normalize_Value,Burden_Adj,everything()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("Percentile"), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(Child_PID = as.factor(Child_PID)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = Child_PID, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkorchid", high = "dodgerblue",na.value = "white") +
  theme_classic() 


```
